verdict.rationale: Finix documents its own tools for monetizing payments and setting the fees sellers pay, covering the sell-rate half of the story. That includes customizable fee schemas, per-payment-method fees, volume discounts and international charges. Fee reports are automated, but nothing in the pack documents a published buy rate or interchange-level cost breakdown for managing the spread. missing for 10: documented buy rate or cost basis from Finix, interchange-level cost visibility, explicit spread/margin reporting, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I control the economics — a documented buy rate from the provider and freedom to set the sell rate my sellers see, with interchange-level cost visibility to manage the spread

citations.quote: Finix allows you to easily monetize your payments. We offer out of the box customizability, efficiency, and revenue growth tools.
Some of the fee customizations available are: International charges, Transaction volume discounts, Applying fees per payment method, Accelerate settlement timeframes
Test card payments, configure fees schemas, set payout schedules, and more.
From transactions to disputes and fees, more than 10 report types are automated and available in your personal dashboard
